layers.all_views_boundary: eligible campaigns retain 14-day all-views metrics in Unified Reporting and API
layers.comparison_rule: reports spanning 2026-01-01 or mixing standard and all-views fields require methodology and field-version labels before trend comparison

layers.documented_model: 14-day last-touch; the most recent eligible click receives conversion credit
layers.tag_boundary: tag taxonomy determines reporting granularity; create one tenant-scoped tag per approved tactic only after product, channel, publisher and ownership review
layers.mobile_boundary: in-app browsers can undercount conversions when shoppers are not logged in or redirected to the Amazon app; annotate this limitation instead of fabricating lift
layers.causal_boundary: Amazon Attribution is attributed outcome reporting, not proof of incremental lift or a substitute for platform-native attribution

layers.privacy_boundary: only pseudonymized inputs are accepted and only aggregated anonymous outputs are accessible; no raw PII or cross-advertiser signal reuse
layers.activation_boundary: analysis, query generation, audience creation, audience activation and first-party signal onboarding are separate permissioned actions
layers.lookback_evidence: current product page documents 25 months of ad traffic signals; each dataset and query still requires live schema and availability verification
layers.native_ai_boundary: Ads Agent in AMC may generate queries or audience segments, but output review, privacy thresholds, account routing and activation approval remain mandatory

layers.freshness_boundary: hourly summarized push data is near real time, not instantaneous transaction truth
layers.execution_boundary: stream data can inform alerts and drafts; any automated bid, budget or campaign change still requires verified routing and owner approval

layers.comparison_rule: 7-day prompt orders and units must not be silently combined with Amazon Attribution 14-day last-touch or Unified Reporting all-views metrics

distilled_rules: Amazon Attribution、Amazon Store 统一报告、AMC、Marketing Stream 和 Prompts 报告是五个不同测量层，必须保留来源、窗口、模型、字段版本和账户范围
Amazon Attribution 衡量站外营销对 Amazon 店内结果的归因，采用 14 天 last-touch；不得把其结果写成因果增量或直接替代 Meta、TikTok、Google 的平台归因
2026-01-01 起部分 vCPM Sponsored Brands/Display 与店内 DSP 的标准 view-attributed 报告方法发生变化；跨日期趋势必须标记方法切换，click-based attribution 保持独立
AMC 仅接收假名化输入并只输出聚合匿名结果；查询草稿不等于已运行，受众创建不等于已激活，信号上传不等于允许跨租户复用
Marketing Stream 是按小时推送的近实时报告层，不是实时订单账本；无 Ads API、AWS 目的地和开发资源时保持 blocked_connector
Prompts 的 7 天订单/件数、Amazon Attribution 的 14 天 last-touch、统一报告的标准或 all-views 字段不得混算成单一 ROAS
